ChatRoom.title: ChatRoom
ChatRoom.description: A real-time group, community, or direct conversation room.

id.description: Unique identifier of the chat room

name.description: Display name of the group or room

description.description: Description or topic of the group

avatarUrl.description: URL of the room profile or group image

avatarEmoji.description: Display emoji icon for the room

creatorId.description: User ID of the room creator

adminIds.description: List of user IDs with group administrator privileges

isOfficial.description: Whether this is an official Bethelincovibe TV platform-wide room

participants.description: List of user IDs participating in the conversation

participantNames.description: Mapping of user ID to display name

participantAvatars.description: Mapping of user ID to avatar URL

onlyAdminsCanPost.description: Whether only group administrators can send messages

onlyAdminsCanEditInfo.description: Whether only group administrators can edit group settings

lastMessageText.description: Snippet of the most recent message

lastMessageSenderId.description: User ID of the last message sender

lastMessageSenderName.description: Display name of the last message sender

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the room was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the room was last modified

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual real-time message inside a chat room.

chatId.description: ID of the parent chat room

fileName.description: Original file name for document/file attachments

fileSize.description: Size of attached file in bytes

mediaDuration.description: Duration in seconds for voice notes or videos

replyTo.description: Referenced parent message object for replies

reactions.description: Emoji reaction mapping with user lists

readBy.description: List of user IDs who have seen this message

deletedForEveryone.description: Whether the message content has been deleted for all participants

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent

ChatTypingState.title: ChatTypingState
ChatTypingState.description: Real-time typing activity indicator for a specific user in a chat room.

userId.description: User ID of the typing member

userName.description: Display name of the typing member

isTyping.description: Whether the user is currently typing

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last typing heartbeat

UserPresence.title: UserPresence
UserPresence.description: Real-time presence and active status of a user.

lastSeen.description: Server timestamp of last active interaction

/chats/{chatId}.description: Collection of direct, group, and community chat conversations.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Sub-collection of ordered messages inside each chat room.

/chats/{chatId}/typing/{userId}.description: Sub-collection of typing indicators per user inside a chat room.

/presence/{userId}.description: Global presence indicators for active users on the platform.
